raw.query: SELECT MIN(m.mean_ms / a.aic_ms) AS min_ratio, MAX(m.mean_ms / a.aic_ms) AS max_ratio FROM (SELECT n_images, mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_fn WHERE engine = 'measured_5x50' AND n_images <= 64) m JOIN (SELECT n_images, aic_ms FROM provenance.collector_fn WHERE engine = 'aic_postinfill' AND n_images <= 64) a ON m.n_images = a.n_images
raw.evidence: The ratio of HuggingFace eager (measured_5x50) to the AIC composition (aic_postinfill) ranges from 1.3599 (at N=8) to 1.6159 (at N=64), supporting 1.4–1.6x at one-decimal precision.
